# Stamps, SRC-20 & SRC-101

> Bitcoin Stamps transforms transaction data into lasting digital culture. SRC-20 brings fungible assets; SRC-101 adds names and records.

## Public experience

- Home: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/src-20/
- Discover: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/src-20/reference.html
- Get started: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/src-20/guide.html
- Bitcoin Universe: https://inscribe.bitcoinuniverse.io/

## The experience

- Stamps: Discover art and culture preserved through Bitcoin transaction history.
- SRC-20: Explore fungible assets with deploy, mint, and transfer activity.
- SRC-101: Build identity through namespaces, unique names, renewals, and records.

## In plain language

- Durable media: Stamps content is carried through Bitcoin transaction data.
- Community assets: SRC-20 tracks token supply and balances through compatible services.
- Onchain names: SRC-101 gives names a distinct ownership and renewal lifecycle.
- Shared history: Confirmed transactions form the timeline behind each experience.

## User safety

Bitcoin confirms the transaction; compatible Stamps services interpret asset and name activity. Never share a seed phrase, never blind-sign, and always verify recipients, amounts, outputs, and fees.

## Community resources

- Enter the Bitcoin Stamps ecosystem: https://stampchain.io/
- Discover SRC-101: https://bitcoinuniverse.github.io/src-101/
